source_snapshot.items: DIMM VR over temperature via heat gun
source_snapshot.procedure: Qualified physical heating through TWarning and then TCritical while observing BMC WebUI.
source_snapshot.criteria: Reasonable sensor range, IPMI/WebUI agreement and SEL event at threshold.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; correctly keeps heating manual but omits SEL/WebUI correlation and invents throttling.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; target, signed thresholds/tolerances, calibrated probe, bounded fixture and cooldown are required.

old_problem: The row omitted board-specific TWarning/TCritical values, reasonable-range and cross-interface tolerance, heating geometry/rate, independent measurement, stop limit and cooldown/deassertion acceptance.
disposition_reason: The physical target, two-stage purpose, observation method and safe stop/recovery structure are clear. ED-03 permits target mapping, threshold values, fixture geometry and tolerances as mandatory runtime configuration; ED-09 retains heat application with a qualified human, and ED-15 prohibits PASS until signed thresholds exist. Both TWarning and TCritical coverage are preserved, with separate authorization before the critical stage, so Pending is removed without inventing values.
decision_basis: Directly read XLSX Reliability rows 12 and 13 and same-row DeepSeek fields.
Read historical record 2418 and preserved exact identity/hashes.
Preserve ordered TWarning then TCritical assertion; a single critical overshoot does not cover the warning stage.
Require an independent calibrated probe because BMC telemetry cannot safely control localized hot-air stimulus.
Reject DeepSeek's throttling claim because source Criteria require sensor/log behavior, not DIMM throttling.
No heat, BIOS change, injection, power action or DUT test occurred.

test_case.test_name: Controlled DIMM-VR TWarning and TCritical sensor/SEL validation
test_case.purpose: Validate the mapped DIMM-VR temperature sensor across separately observed warning and critical thresholds, correlate independent temperature with WebUI/IPMI, verify SEL assertion/deassertion, and recover without damage.
required_package: Signed TWarning/TCritical, hysteresis, maximum-safe limit and interface/probe tolerances
Calibrated independent probe and approved shielded heat fixture geometry/ramp/dwell
Ambient/cooling/load configuration and emergency stop/cooldown/inspection procedure
test_case.test_command: A qualified operator identifies/shields the exact VR and controls a fixed heat source while an independent probe plus synchronized BMC WebUI/IPMI/SEL monitoring records temperature. Ramp slowly to TWarning, hold only as approved and capture assertion; after separate confirmation, proceed toward TCritical without exceeding the signed stop limit, capture assertion, remove heat, restore cooling and verify hysteresis/deassertion and post-test health.
test_case.expected_result: The independent probe and BMC interfaces agree within the signed tolerance; TWarning asserts first and TCritical asserts only at its approved boundary; required SEL records identify the correct sensor; no unrelated fault/damage occurs; both thresholds deassert per hysteresis and the assembly returns healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires signed limits, complete ordered warning/critical evidence, calibrated correlation, correct SEL identity/timestamps, no overshoot or unrelated fault, and verified cooldown/deassertion. Missing thresholds, literal unbounded `reasonable`, a single critical overshoot, unsupported throttling evidence or absent recovery is not PASS.
safety_gate: Qualified operator, dedicated SUT, shielding and calibrated independent probe are mandatory.
Verify baseline sensor agreement and preserve logs before heating.
Stop on rapid rise, probe/BMC disagreement, smoke/odor/noise, discoloration, cooling/power anomaly or maximum limit.
Critical-stage authorization is separate; no automatic retry and no AI control of the heat source.
expected_evidence: Timestamped probe, WebUI and IPMI traces with tolerance calculation
Ordered TWarning and TCritical plus SEL assertion evidence
Hysteresis/deassertion, cooldown, physical inspection and health
test_case.recovery: Immediately remove heat on any abort, maintain approved cooling, preserve logs, and allow the qualified operator to inspect the VR/DIMM/PCB. Do not power-cycle damaged hardware or retry automatically; resume only after temperature, sensor state and platform health return to the approved baseline.

source_conflict.reason: Undefined values are converted to mandatory signed runtime bindings; Procedure's two ordered thresholds are both required, and Criteria are made measurable without adding throttling.

blocked.reason: The method and recovery boundary are complete at review layer; project thresholds, target and fixture are execution prerequisites.

pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED AS PARAMETERIZED HYBRID THERMAL TEST; NO HEAT OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: Thermal/hardware owner binds limits; qualified operator owns heat; end engineer owns verdict.

project_authority: The board thermal specification, BMC sensor/SEL map and calibrated lab procedure are authoritative for limits, tolerances, fixture and recovery.
